static_traits.name: Lin Jiexi
static_traits.educational_background: Having taken cooking classes while growing up
static_traits.social_status: Recently distant from friends and family, tends toward self-isolation
static_traits.medical_history: No important physical illness; no prior psychotherapy or psychological problem history
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, highly cooperative, able to self-Reflect; but frequently using negative labels and absolutist expressions (such as 'I am a failure'), Low mood, steady speech rate

basic_info.main_problem: Since failing a cooking show audition recently, persistently feeling like a 'failure', constantly ruminating on that failure; whenever thinking of the audition or seeing cooking-related content, feeling low self-esteem and insufficiency, Decreased motivation and Social avoidance, daily cooking habits disrupted.
basic_info.core_demands: I decided to come for counseling because I noticed this sense of failure is affecting my motivation to keep pursuing the dream of becoming a Chef.
growth_experiences: Growing up receiving systematic cooking courses, gradually developing a love for cooking and professional aspirations, long aiming to become a Chef.
Never experienced similar failure or major setbacks before, also never received psychotherapy, making this audition failure a rare strong negative experience, lacking experience coping with failure.

core_beliefs: I am not good enough / incompetent

special_situations.event: The announcement of the cooking show audition result (not passed)
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If unable to succeed in one go on key occasions, it proves I am not suited to be a Chef, I am just a failure
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Self-reproach, stopping usual practice and attempts, Avoids socializing to avoid being judged
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am just a failure, I may not be suited to be a Chef

special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Any cooking-related cue will remind me of this failure, and prove I am not good enough
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reducing cooking, using TV watching and other Distraction to avoid uncomfortable cues
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: This again proves I am no good / I will never catch up

special_situations.event: Recalling the judges' feedback at the audition (including positive comments but overall not passed)
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Only 'passing / success' counts, any positive feedback does not count as real proof of ability
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Actively ignores and devalues positive information to maintain the consistency of the self-label
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Those praises are meaningless, failing to pass means I am completely no good

special_situations.event: Friends or family try to contact, or thinking about meeting them
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If they knew I failed, they would look down on me or be disappointed
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids contact with relatives and friends, choosing self-isolation to avoid embarrassment and judgment
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They will think I am awful

core_conflict.wish: Longing to be recognized through achievements, proving one's value as a Chef and being affirmed
core_conflict.fear: Fearing failure means one is utterly worthless, will be negated and humiliated by others, dreams shattered
defense_goal: Maintains control and drives change through self-harshness
Keeping distance from others to reduce shame and Anxiety from negative evaluation

object_relations.self_representation: A not-good-enough failure who may be eliminated
object_relations.object_representation: Critical, judgmental others (such as judges, surrounding people)

object_relations.self_representation: One unworthy of contact with others, needing to hide failure
object_relations.object_representation: Others (friends/family) who would be disappointed or look down on oneself

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor or others point out her strengths in auditions / positive feedback received
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Tending to see others' affirmation as politeness or not counting (transferentially experiencing others as objects who 'do not truly recognize me')
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Gentle and specific tone, inviting evidence and detailed situations, first Empathizing with their shame and loss, then gently integrating positive and negative evidence, avoiding confrontational rebuttal.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When talking about failure and being invited to discuss next-step plans or contact people
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Turning potential outward anger / loss into self-blame, believing oneself unworthy, should not express needs
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: First validating and naming the pain brought by self-criticism, use gentle reflection and restatement to help externalize the 'harsh inner voice', encouraging expressing needs in first person and trying small feasible actions.

manifestations: After failing an audition, actively distances from friends and family, finding it hard to share feelings of failure with supportive friends
outcomes: Social withdrawal and isolation worsening Low mood
Insufficient support system use, Recovery slowing down

manifestations: Doubting suitability to become a Chef after setbacks, Decreased drive, losing interest in once-loved cooking
outcomes: Confusion and wavering about his career path and sense of self-worth

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: Evaluates himself with rigid rules such as 'I must/should succeed' (equating success with self-worth)
Taking 'not passing = having no value' as an absolute standard

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Frequent self-blame and negative self-labeling ('I am a failure')
Worries about others' evaluations and withdraws expression, hard to share experiences with supportive friends

contact_model.definition: The individual ignores or avoids a stimulus from the internal or external environment, deliberately avoiding direct contact, corresponding to 'acceptance'.
manifestations: Avoiding post-failure shame and powerlessness with Distraction like watching TV
Quickly turning back to the 'still not good enough' narrative when invited to focus on positive evidence

exception_events.target_problem: When facing high-pressure cooking-related situations (such as auditions, online cooking content), the client usually experiences surging Self-deprecation and failure labels, then avoids practice and socializing, Decreased drive.
exception_events.unique_outcome: On the audition day, despite nervousness, still able to engage in cooking and complete the dish, and a judge affirmed the dish's flavor, deviating from the dominant story of 'total failure / utterly worthless'.
exception_events.reason: Clues: focusing on the cooking process in the moment (different approach), passion for cooking and a foundation of long-term training (different resources), and receiving immediate positive feedback on site (different support), together led to engagement in the moment and some positive outcomes.

positive_force: His love of cooking and the training foundation accumulated while growing up
Ability to still complete work under high-pressure scenes and gain some positive feedback
Willing to seek help and try viewing setbacks in a more balanced way (self-Reflection ability)
negative_force: A way of thinking with catastrophizing, overgeneralization, and self-labeling
negating positive information, only focusing on the mental filter of failure
Social avoidance and self-isolation, weakening the support system
Rigidly binds success and failure to self-worth (a 'must succeed' rule)

target_behavior.behavior: Repeated Self-deprecation and rumination (such as 'I am a failure'), accompanied by avoidance of cooking activities
antecedent: Thinking about or discussing audition failures
target_behavior.core_reason: Equating one failure with a negation of overall ability and self-worth, lacking failure experience and corresponding coping scripts, accompanied by high sensitivity to external evaluation and shame
target_behavior.function: Escaping shame and Anxiety in the short term, maintaining a subjective sense of control over the situation
target_behavior.consequence: Cooking practice and daily routine disrupted, career Decreased motivation, Low mood and a sense of powerlessness worsening

antecedent: Friends or family reaching out / inviting proactively
Thinking one might be evaluated or asked about audition results
target_behavior.core_reason: Worrying about being negated by others and shame exposure, seeing failure as shameful and needing to hide it
target_behavior.function: Avoiding possible negative evaluation and awkward situations, reducing Anxiety in the short term
target_behavior.consequence: Loneliness and Low mood worsening, external support and positive feedback decreasing, Recovery hindered
